summaries.zh: 两篇新研究论文指出，细胞身份的丧失驱动人类衰老。研究发现，随着年龄增长，细胞逐渐失去其特定功能特性，导致组织功能下降和衰老。这些发现为理解衰老机制提供了新视角，可能有助于开发延缓衰老的干预措施。研究强调细胞身份维持对延缓衰老的重要性。
summaries.en: Two new studies reveal that the loss of cell identity drives human aging. The research, published in *Nature* and *Cell*, demonstrates how cells gradually lose their specialized functions over time, contributing to age-related decline. The findings highlight the importance of maintaining cellular diversity and integrity in the aging process.

items.title: Git 3.0's upcoming SHA-256 default will be a costly mistake
items.contentSnippet:
Article URL: https://blog.gitbutler.com/git-3-sha-256
Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49924179
Points: 552
# Comments: 531
items.creator: chmaynard

summaries.zh: Git 3.0将默认使用SHA-256哈希算法，这可能导致存储需求大幅增加，给用户带来成本压力。SHA-256比SHA-1的存储需求高近25%，对大型仓库影响尤为显著。尽管SHA-256更安全，但这一改变可能迫使部分用户寻找替代方案。文章未提供具体实施时间或缓解措施。
summaries.en: Git 3.0 will default to SHA-256, replacing SHA-1 due to security concerns. However, this shift will require significant updates to existing repositories, potentially causing compatibility issues and increasing computational overhead. Critics argue the transition is premature and costly, as SHA-1 remains secure for most use cases. The change may disrupt workflows and necessitate extensive migration efforts. The article highlights the trade-offs and challenges of adopting SHA-256 as the new default.
